opening.argument: The presentation makes a direct investment solicitation built around easy, passive returns. Viewers are told they can take Bitcoin, place it on the platform, and receive a daily return on their initial investment, while also getting their capital back. The process is reduced to transferring Bitcoin, lending it, and waiting for money to accrue, presenting participation as requiring little skill or effort. The speaker further discloses a personal financial incentive: "so I promote the site you join, I get paid." He then directs interested viewers to join through a link in the description. These combined claims of daily returns and returned capital, passive participation, affiliate compensation, and an explicit enrollment link support the conclusion that the video solicits deceptive investment participation.
